scope: Same fixed 2.1M synthetic events and 683 generated arrays per arm; no producer, codec, adapter, validator, comparison, storage, or scientific threshold change.
rationale: Old target B had only 978,494 events in SHA-verified committed blocks when its 180-second deadline stopped the run. At that committed-block pace, a simple 2.1M-event extrapolation is about 386 seconds. A 480-second arm ceiling adds a bounded margin, while preserving all logical events and strict validators. This extrapolation is illustrative, not proof that B or C will finish.
approval_boundary: Review of this engineering policy is separate from a new one-shot target run authorization. The old authorization is consumed and its HOLD remains final.
